title: Modular evolution and regulatory diversification of nodD-like LysR-type transcriptional regulators in alpha-Proteobacteria.
authors: Koech, Nelly; Muoma, John; Banerjee, Aparna; Okoth, Patrick; Wekesa, Clabe
one_liner_zh: 该文研究alpha-变形菌中nodD类LysR型转录调控因子的进化与调控多样化，虽涉及TF-DNA结合靶标预测，但核心是进化与基因组分析，非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法上仅用AlphaFold结构比较，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: The nodD gene encodes a LysR-type transcriptional regulator critical for nodulation gene expression in rhizobia, yet its evolutionary origin, structural plasticity, and regulatory reach beyond symbiosis remain incompletely resolved. Here we investigate the genomic organization, structural variation, and functional diversification of nodD and its homologs across alpha-proteobacteria with selected outgroups. Using orthogroup-based pangenome clustering, dated species trees, and gene-tree-species-tree reconciliation, we reconstruct the evolutionary trajectory of nodD, indicating emergence from ancient LTTRs deep in proteobacterial history. Reconciliation reveals widespread duplication and horizontal gene transfer (HGT), with several rhizobia showing notable duplication and exchange, and marine/non-rhizobial taxa contributing to a mosaic of nodD-like genes. Gene-neighborhood and operon analyses show conserved syntenic tendencies in classical rhizobia but extensive architectural divergence in free-living lineages, including frequent monocistronic anchors with extended upstream regions and, when polycistronic, enrichment for transporters and local metabolic enzymes within compact multi-regulator cassettes. Structural comparisons with AlphaFold and PyMOL confirm the canonical LTTR fold while uncovering species-specific deviations concentrated in effector-binding loops and interfaces. Motif discovery and genome-wide scanning identify targets involved in metabolism, stress responses, and transcriptional control, and network analysis reveals modular connectivity spanning core metabolism and accessory processes such as secondary metabolism, transport, and biofilm-associated functions. These findings portray nodD as a structurally conserved yet functionally flexible regulator repeatedly reshaped by duplication, HGT, and local genome context, extending nodD-like systems beyond symbiosis and broadening the regulatory landscape of bacterial LTTRs.
abstract_zh: nodD基因编码一种LysR型转录调控因子，对根瘤菌中结瘤基因表达至关重要，但其进化起源、结构可塑性以及超越共生关系的调控范围仍未完全阐明。本研究调查了nodD及其同源基因在α-变形菌纲（alpha-proteobacteria）及选定外群中的基因组组织、结构变异和功能多样化。利用基于直系同源群的泛基因组聚类、定年物种树以及基因树-物种树协调分析，我们重建了nodD的进化轨迹，表明其源自变形菌纲历史深处古老的LTTRs。协调分析揭示了广泛的复制和水平基因转移（HGT），若干根瘤菌表现出显著的复制和交换，而海洋/非根瘤菌类群则贡献了nodD样基因的镶嵌结构。基因邻域和操纵子分析显示，经典根瘤菌中保守的共线性趋势，但在自由生活谱系中则呈现广泛的结构分歧，包括频繁的单顺反子锚定基因伴随延伸的上游区域，以及在多顺反子情况下，紧凑的多调控因子盒内富集转运蛋白和局部代谢酶。利用AlphaFold和PyMOL进行的结构比较确认了典型的LTTR折叠，同时揭示了集中在效应子结合环和界面上的物种特异性偏差。基序发现和全基因组扫描识别出涉及代谢、应激反应和转录调控的靶标，网络分析则揭示了跨越核心代谢及次级代谢、转运和生物膜相关功能等附属过程的模块化连接。这些发现将nodD描绘为一种结构保守但功能灵活的调控因子，通过复制、HGT和局部基因组背景反复重塑，将nodD样系统扩展至共生之外，并拓宽了细菌LTTRs的调控景观。
